title: Our Book!
body:
## Imagination As Protocol: A Community Technology Guide (2026)




*What if invention began with care and we treated relationships as infrastructure? Future Inventions gathers research, reflections, and creative prompts exploring alternative histories and futures of technology, inviting readers to expand their technological imagination and reconsider what technology is, where it comes from, and who gets to make it.*

We worked on this publication for 3 months, synthesising two years of research, conversations, and ideas into a physical object that we hope can inspire the kind of discussions that a typical F.I session holds.

There is a mix of theory, case studies, exercise sheets, and resources, which make this a tool for imagining technologies otherwise - either individually or with a group.

The book has no fixed beginning or end. With multiple covers, you can start wherever you end up, much like how we move through time.

54 pages, commissioned by Peckham Digital,designed by Ana Marques and printed by Calvert’s Press. 

Limited Edition, Second Run coming
